Question: asalamualykum sir 1) i want to now about fajr sunah , if our fajr salah left,should we read it after 20 minutes with sunah of two rakats. after zawal time or zohor salah time we want to read fajr salah, should we read it with sunah of two rakats or not if we are performing kazaye umri we read fajr sunah or not. 2) sir my English communication skill is very poor for that's reason i cannot pass many interview i m failed in many process, please sir tell me any dua or amal for that i can pass interview and my communication skill become excellent, i m also try for learn better English. Answer ID: 10521 Posted on: Aug 30, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 195/179=B/1429) (1) In case the Fajr salah is missed, one will pray sunnah as well if it is performed before zawal , but after zawal only two obligatory rakaah of Fajr will be performed. (2) Recite the below duas thrice each and blow on your chest: سبحانک لا علم لنا الا ما علمتنا انک انت العلیم الحکیم رب اشرح لی صدری و یسر لی امری واحلل عقدۃ من لسانی یفقھوا قولی Likewise, recite these duas when start learning English. Practice speaking English with your friends and read daily English newspaper. Read a paragraph repeatedly so that you are accustomed to pronounce English words. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
